notes.title: About the future of Nonsense Soccer
notes.notes:
Hey, all fans of nonsensical soccer! It's me, the developer (AnttiKole)!

Great news!

After acquiring the studio, I've decided to transfer dev of the game officially under Parta Games 👉effective immediately!

This allows me to formally continue the dev of the game with access to larger resources ✨

Obviously we have one big game to ship next year (Choppa: Rescue Rivals), which will take up most of my time, in addition to our secret customer projects, but it definitely means a more secure future for this little obscure game I'm very proud of.

Nonsense has been on an update hiatus since 2022, for personal reasons. I just didn't have the time to develop a local multiplayer game by myself, while working full time on other games. I'd love to continue sooner rather than later.

But I hope this reassures you it's not one of those abandoned early access games! The plan is in motion 😁

P.S. This is the big news I was teasing a while back, unless it's clear. Life, uh, finds a way!

notes.title: Update 0.6.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Menu overhaul

I basically revised most, if not all of the main and in-game menus. Nonsense looks a lot prettier and is intuitive now, at least I think so! :)

The team select screen is still a bit work in progress and some of the menu transitions are a bit annoying (like when you return from the game, most of the player-made settings reset). I'll get around to fixing them as soon as I can :)

I've been pretty busy with work stuff so no gameplay changes in this update, but I've scheduled some improvements and new features for the next one. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update notes for 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Changelist 0.5.1:
- Fixed: Using modifiers in a match, caused the next match to not start correctly
- Fixed: Using modifiers broke the main menu
- Fixed: Both team's score indicators were reset after each replay
- Fixed: Spawning glitched after replay playback had stopped
- Fixed: Various replay sound glitches
- Fixed: Various graphical glitches

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi fans of Nonsense!

Here it is, the first update after the dreaded development hiatus. I've been really anxious about getting new stuff out and was struggling a bit getting back into the groove. Please leave a review and send me some love and feedback in the community forums if you have time.

Changelist:
[list]
[*] New replay feature! Each goal now has a replay :)
[*] Visual improvements here and there
[*] Fixed: Sometimes the ball and players were stuck inside walls
[*] Improved behaviour when running up and down slopes
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: End of hiatus and a small price increase
notes.notes:
Hi fans of Nonsense!

As some of you may know, I announced my short hiatus back in December and since then there have been no updates released for Nonsense Soccer. The good news is I'm now back & continuing development. Expect some more development streams and update announcements in the near future. My aim is to make this the best dumb multiplayer soccer game on Steam!

I've also set a new price for the game. It is now $2.99 (increased from $1.99), which is still a fair price for the game as it is now. That's how I feel at least! :)

It's been really fun seeing many folks enjoy this little game I'm making. Hoping you will like what Nonsense I've got in store in the future.

Antti

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 is out now!
notes.notes:
I didn't quite manage to make it a Christmas miracle, but better late than never: Update #4, also known as 0.4.0 is now live on Steam!

It includes some community requested features like rule modifiers and lots of other new stuff. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1352130/discussions/0/2998800559161799005/]changelist[/url]

Let me know what you think in the community forums! I hope you enjoy the new stuff and have a happy new year 2021!
